test.name: build URL slashes
test.url: library(Rlabkey) urls <- c( labkey.buildURL("https://lk.test", "query", "selectRows.api", "home"), labkey.buildURL("https://lk.test/", "query", "selectRows.api", "/home/"), labkey.buildURL("https://lk.test/labkey", "query", "selectRows.api", "/my folder/sub"), labkey.buildURL("https://lk.test", "query", "selectRows.api", "/"), labkey.buildURL("https://lk.test", "query", "getQueries.api", "home", list(schemaName="lists"))) cat(paste0("url: ", urls, "\n"), sep="") cat("doubled slash:", any(grepl("[^:]//", urls)), "\n")
test.response: url: https://lk.test/home/query-selectRows.api url: https://lk.test/labkey/my%20folder/sub/query-selectRows.api url: https://lk.test/query-selectRows.api url: https://lk.test/home/query-getQueries.api?schemaName=lists doubled slash: FALSE
